name: wall_has_a_name
why: ENTRY Z-F1. Do not repeat a number, give it a name: a global variable «wall» and the thickness of the plate linked to it. Changing the variable changes the part, by construction. Measured on 27/9/2026 (probe0089 zf1, zf1b): Add3 returns the index; the linked dimension follows the variable (96000 -> 115200 -> 144000 mm3); get_Status cannot be read (-1 even when it works) and the outcome is taken from the values re-read; «spessore» is a name already taken in the Italian SOLIDWORKS.
defect_caught: A variable written that drives nothing; a link that the equation accepts and the dimension does not follow; the change of the variable that does not reach the part without EvaluateAll and a rebuild; the name refused by SOLIDWORKS taken for good.

expect.why: a variable that nobody uses does not change the part
the dimension re-read is worth as much as the equation
120 x 80 x 15: changing the variable changes the part
